n1a66e3da5b.why: ENR's Top 250 ranks the world's largest international construction contractors, and Turkish firms' presence signals their global project activity.

n2f3a40b52f.summary: The Greek government is considering a new extension of its 10-cent-per-litre diesel pump subsidy. The move follows a rally in international oil prices that pushed unleaded and diesel above two euros.
n2f3a40b52f.why: Fuel subsidies affect consumer prices and government spending. Greek pump prices track international crude and refined product markets.

n621db23ac6.summary: Konfederacja Lewiatan said the government's proposed corporate income tax increase for some companies may weaken investment and add tax uncertainty. It also said PIT changes may reduce wage growth pressure.
n621db23ac6.why: Corporate income tax rates affect company cash flows and investment decisions, and business lobby groups such as Lewiatan represent employers in Poland.

n695f4d5fe9.summary: Warsaw's Regional Prosecutor's Office filed the 16th indictment in the GetBack S.A. case. It concerns alleged damage exceeding 1.3 billion zlotys, with two people facing up to 25 years in prison.
n695f4d5fe9.why: GetBack was a Polish debt-collection and lending company, and the case is a major test of accountability in the country's corporate finance sector.

n10c350486d.summary: CSG N.V. shares declined 3.2 percent even as the company reported a strong first half with double-digit growth. The order backlog reached 46 (unit not stated in the input).
n10c350486d.why: CSG (Czechoslovak Group) is a Europe-based defence and industrial group listed in Amsterdam and Prague, so its order intake and backlog are closely watched by defence-sector investors.

nd4794da696.why: The TAIEX is Taiwan's benchmark index, heavily weighted toward semiconductor makers, so its moves reflect the global chip cycle and regional risk sentiment.

n5e62ab4142.headline: IDX Confirms Green Equity Designation Follows Global Standards
n5e62ab4142.summary: Indonesia Stock Exchange (IDX) confirmed implementation of the Green Equity Designation for companies listed on the capital market. The designation is described as following global standards.
n5e62ab4142.why: The Indonesia Stock Exchange operates Indonesia's main equity market, so its listing rules and sustainability labels affect how investors screen local companies.

ne06245a273.headline: Iran's Qalibaf Urges Baghdad to Break Economic Dependence on Washington
ne06245a273.summary: Iranian Parliament Speaker Mohammad Baqer Qalibaf urged Baghdad to cut its reliance on the dollar and draft a roadmap for economic cooperation. He spoke in Najaf as Iraq awaits new US sanctions on Iran.
ne06245a273.why: Iraq's dollar-denominated oil revenues and banking links with the US make its currency arrangements sensitive to US sanctions. Shifts away from the dollar affect trade settlement and regional financial flows.

nd9cc543b6b.headline: Rwanda: MPs Approve Rwf279bn Financing to Boost Job Creation
nd9cc543b6b.summary: Rwanda's Chamber of Deputies approved two financing agreements worth a combined Rwf279 billion. The funds support government programmes aimed at decent and sustainable job creation.
nd9cc543b6b.why: Government financing agreements, often with multilateral lenders, affect public debt levels and the funding of development programmes.

nbf1fbb2bd4.headline: Mozambique: Government Lays First Stone for 9.4 Million Dollars Topuito Industrial Park
nbf1fbb2bd4.summary: The Mozambican government launched construction of the Topuito Industrial Park in Larde district, Nampula province. The project is budgeted at $9.4 million.
nbf1fbb2bd4.why: Industrial parks attract manufacturing investment and create jobs, which can support export growth and economic diversification in developing economies.

n6f0bddcead.headline: Walmart Stock Falls 9 Percent After Missing Comparable Sales For The First Time In Five Years
n6f0bddcead.summary: Walmart shares fell as much as 10% to a nine-month low after missing comparable sales for the first time in five years, despite beating revenue and earnings.
n6f0bddcead.why: Walmart is the largest US retailer, and its same-store sales trends are closely watched as a gauge of consumer spending.

impacts.name: Walmart
impacts.why: The stock fell sharply after the company reported a comparable-sales miss in its quarterly results.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

n6f0bddcead.why_moved: Investors reacted to the first comparable-sales miss in five years, the stock's worst single-day drop since May 2022, despite beats on revenue and earnings.

n3495b9d56a.headline: Ships Trickle Through Strait of Hormuz
n3495b9d56a.summary: Seven commodity ships sailed through the Strait of Hormuz on Thursday, half the previous day's count, according to shiptracker Kpler. The drop came amid concern over regional risks.
n3495b9d56a.why: The Strait of Hormuz carries a large share of seaborne oil and LNG, so shipping volumes there influence energy supply.
n3495b9d56a.why_moved: Fewer ships passing through the Strait of Hormuz, amid concern over regional risks, raises fears of supply disruption for oil and gas.

n2139a5b85b.headline: S&P affirms OQ Gas Networks’ BBB- rating
n2139a5b85b.summary: S&P Global Ratings has affirmed its 'BBB-' long-term issuer credit rating on OQ Gas Networks, Oman's gas transmission company. The rating affirmation was reported from Muscat.
n2139a5b85b.why: OQ Gas Networks is a gas pipeline and distribution business in Oman, and its credit rating affects the cost of its borrowing and investor perception of its debt.

n107b7af7ff.headline: Australia slips further behind 1.2m new homes target
n107b7af7ff.summary: Australia is slipping further behind its 1.2 million new homes target, with the Middle East conflict and higher interest rates hitting project feasibility for builders. Advocates are calling for action.
n107b7af7ff.why: Housing construction targets reflect the supply of new dwellings, and higher rates and build costs weigh on residential developers and building activity.

ncce60df68a.headline: South Korea's Doosan wins major EPC contract for Misfah power project
ncce60df68a.summary: South Korea's Doosan Enerbility disclosed a major engineering, procurement and construction contract for Oman's 1,700MW Misfah power project. The announcement was made in Muscat.
ncce60df68a.why: Doosan Enerbility is a South Korean power-equipment and engineering group. EPC contracts for large power plants bring revenue visibility for industrial suppliers.

n9ad6b9da40.headline: Citadel unwinds 80% of Situational Awareness portfolio
n9ad6b9da40.summary: Citadel executed more than 100 block trades worth over $4 billion to shed the positions, according to Ken Griffin. The hedge fund reduced its Situational Awareness portfolio by about 80%.
n9ad6b9da40.why: Citadel is a major US hedge fund led by Ken Griffin, and large block trades by such funds can affect the prices of the positions being sold.

n3407d02671.headline: Are big retailers going to share their billions of dollars in tariff refunds?
n3407d02671.summary: Walmart reported $2.9 billion in tariff refunds along with its quarterly earnings. The company says it will now lower prices for consumers.
n3407d02671.why: Walmart is the largest US retailer, so its tariff refunds and pricing decisions signal how import costs flow through to consumers.

impacts.name: Walmart
impacts.why: Tariff refunds boost reported results while lower prices reduce margins.

n5c6530a454.headline: Big tech companies will have to pay to publish Australian news content under new laws
n5c6530a454.summary: Australia has passed a law requiring major tech platforms such as Google and Meta to strike deals with local news publishers or pay a levy on their advertising revenue.
n5c6530a454.why: Google and Meta are the largest digital advertising platforms, so licensing costs or levies on their ad revenue can affect their earnings in affected markets.

n338ca4b0e4.headline: Brent hovers near $94 as US-Iran conflict continues to squeeze energy supply
n338ca4b0e4.summary: Oil prices extended their weekly rally on Friday, with Brent crude hovering near $94 a barrel. The ongoing US-Iran conflict continues to disrupt energy supplies.
n338ca4b0e4.why: Brent is the principal global crude oil benchmark, and supply disruptions in the Gulf directly move fuel costs and inflation expectations.

impacts.name: Brent crude
impacts.why: Ongoing US-Iran conflict disrupting energy supplies is lifting Brent prices.

n55f93c45c3.headline: Australia PMI Expansion Continues, but Manufacturing Output Slips Back Into Contraction
n55f93c45c3.summary: Australia's composite PMI eased to 52.5 in August as services growth slowed and manufacturing output slipped below 50, although new orders improved.
n55f93c45c3.why: Purchasing managers' indexes track business activity and are used by investors to gauge the health of the economy and the outlook for policy.

nab8af0235b.headline: Nigeria: Manufacturing Remains Largest Contributor to Nigeria
nab8af0235b.summary: A Nigerian Economic Summit Group report says manufacturing's share of industrial output rose to 50.1% in the first quarter of 2026 from 28.2% in 2010, making it the largest contributor.
nab8af0235b.why: Manufacturing's share of output indicates the structure of Nigeria's economy and the health of its industrial base, which matters for investors in Nigerian industry and currency.

ne1eeeae628.headline: Centre allows duty-free import of raw sugar to curb surging prices
ne1eeeae628.summary: The Indian government allowed 1 million tonnes of raw sugar to be imported duty-free until October 31 as domestic prices climb ahead of the festive season.
ne1eeeae628.why: India is one of the world's largest sugar producers and consumers, so import policy affects domestic prices and global sugar trade.

impacts.name: Raw sugar
impacts.why: Additional duty-free imports of raw sugar add supply to the domestic market.

na34432a8bd.headline: Guangzhou Intermediate Court Accepts Evergrande Real Estate Bankruptcy Liquidation Case; Two Residential Plots in Wuhan Donghu High-tech Zone Sold for 835 Million Yuan | Domestic News (8.22)
na34432a8bd.summary: A Guangzhou intermediate court accepted the bankruptcy liquidation case of Evergrande Real Estate. Two residential plots in Wuhan's Donghu High-tech Zone were sold for 835 million yuan.
na34432a8bd.why: Evergrande is one of China's largest property developers, and its debt collapse has been a central test of the country's real estate sector. Court-led liquidation affects creditors and the wider property market.

n92055b3d02.headline: Royal Mail misses delivery targets again but makes progress amid overhaul
n92055b3d02.summary: Royal Mail missed its delivery targets again but made progress during its overhaul, according to first-quarter performance data. The group reported delivery figures for first- and second-class mail.
n92055b3d02.why: Royal Mail is the UK postal operator, owned by International Distributions Services, and its performance affects the group's earnings and regulatory standing.

n9a03de7957.headline: ‘Life is not rosy here’: Migrant workers in Spain’s greenhouses tell of poor pay and hardships
n9a03de7957.summary: Migrant workers in Almería province's greenhouses describe poor pay and hardship, according to a CNN report from the region.
n9a03de7957.why: Spain's Almería greenhouses are a major producer of fresh vegetables for European supermarkets, so labour conditions affect agricultural costs and supply chains.

n55c8dae100.headline: Japan Inflation Accelerates In July, Strengthening Case For Rate Hike In September
n55c8dae100.summary: Japan's core inflation rose to 1.8% in July from 1.6% in June, strengthening expectations of a Bank of Japan rate hike in September. Import costs, a weaker yen and higher energy prices are adding pressure.
n55c8dae100.why: The Bank of Japan sets the country's policy rate, and inflation data shape expectations for rate decisions that affect the yen and Japanese government bond yields.

n86afc29df1.headline: Kakao Mobility submits application for US IPO
n86afc29df1.summary: Kakao Mobility has submitted an application for a US initial public offering, aiming to raise US$1 billion to expand its operations.
n86afc29df1.why: Kakao Mobility is the mobility unit of South Korea's Kakao group, and a US listing would give it access to US capital markets.

n86afa7e094.headline: Amazon Expands Counterfeit Crimes Unit In India To Tackle Fake Product Networks
n86afa7e094.summary: Amazon is expanding its Counterfeit Crimes Unit in India to fight counterfeit products and protect 1.7 million sellers and customers. It is working with Indian law enforcement, including the CBI.
n86afa7e094.why: Amazon is a major online marketplace, and counterfeit enforcement affects its seller trust, regulatory standing and brand protection costs.

nbd462a8aae.headline: Fairfax may get two years to consolidate holdings for IDBI Bank deal
nbd462a8aae.summary: Canada's Fairfax Financial, a frontrunner to acquire the government's stake in IDBI Bank, is set to be allowed up to two years to consolidate its holdings.
nbd462a8aae.why: IDBI Bank is an Indian state-linked lender, and the sale of the government's stake is a major privatisation deal in the country's banking sector.

n88679bc994.headline: US Treasury Secretary Bessent to hold press conference on Monday
n88679bc994.summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent will hold a press conference on Monday, after warning of more Iran sanctions and steps to lower long-dated Treasury yields.
n88679bc994.why: The US Treasury sets sanctions policy and manages government debt issuance, which influences Treasury yields and global financial conditions.

ne5c6587c14.headline: Wall Street rises on the day but falls for the week as bond yields, Iran in focus
ne5c6587c14.summary: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq snapped three-week winning streaks, while the Dow posted its second straight weekly loss. Bond yields and Iran were in focus.
ne5c6587c14.why: The S&P 500 tracks 500 large US companies and is the main gauge of US equity performance.
ne5c6587c14.why_moved: The report links the weekly declines to rising bond yields and developments involving Iran.

n2e3ea103a3.headline: [SMM Announcement] SMM to Launch total six (four billet and two ingot) domestic India Price Assessments — Shanghai Metals Market (SMM)
n2e3ea103a3.summary: Shanghai Metals Market will add six India price assessments covering four billet and two ingot products. The aim is greater price transparency for international market participants.
n2e3ea103a3.why: Price assessments are benchmarks that help metals producers, traders and buyers hedge and value physical contracts. Billets and ingots are semi-finished metal products used in manufacturing.

ndba783554e.headline: UDP Demands Power Rate Rollback; PM Points to Past Neglect
ndba783554e.summary: The United Democratic Party is demanding an immediate rollback of the latest electricity rate increase approved by the Public Utilities Commission. The Prime Minister has pointed to past neglect.
ndba783554e.why: Electricity tariffs set by Belize's regulator affect household costs, business operating expenses and inflation in the country.

n5efa2634d6.summary: Samsung Electronics expects shareholder returns this year of up to 110 trillion won, about $79.5 billion, including 30 trillion won in cash dividends in the third quarter. The figure exceeds the 2020 high of 20.3 trillion won.
n5efa2634d6.why: Samsung is a major global maker of memory chips and smartphones, and its capital return policy shapes investor expectations for South Korea's largest company.

impacts.name: Samsung Electronics

n3012072afd.headline: PFRDA to make maiden AIF investments in two months
n3012072afd.summary: India's Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority will make its first round of investments in alternative investment funds over the next two months. The move would mark its entry into the AIF ecosystem after equity and debt investments.
n3012072afd.why: PFRDA regulates India's national pension system, and its allocation decisions affect large pools of long-term retirement capital.

nfc61c446a2.headline: US$100M Loan from Taiwan: Where Will Money Go?
nfc61c446a2.summary: Belize will access US$40 million this year under a US$100 million concessionary loan from Taiwan, with the government saying the funds are for general financing rather than a specific project.
nfc61c446a2.why: Concessionary loans from partners such as Taiwan help small economies finance budgets and public spending.

n40a290fbba.headline: Bitcoin Consolidates Near $77K as $90K Odds Hit 48%
n40a290fbba.summary: Bitcoin consolidated near $77,000 after recent gains cooled during Friday's Wall Street session. Prediction-market odds of reaching $90,000 this year stand near 48%.
n40a290fbba.why: Bitcoin is the largest cryptocurrency by market value and is a bellwether for digital-asset risk appetite.

n35d309dc4c.headline: 92 organisations and businesses register for carbon exchange system
n35d309dc4c.summary: 92 organisations and businesses, concentrated in steel, cement and thermal power, have registered for Vietnam's carbon credit deposit and settlement system.
n35d309dc4c.why: Carbon credit markets put a price on emissions, affecting heavy industries such as steel, cement and power generation. Participation drives liquidity in the system.

n40f8041fc8.headline: Sugar stocks Balrampur Chini, Dhampur Sugar, others tumble up to 5% as govt allows duty-free imports
n40f8041fc8.summary: Sugar stocks fell sharply after the government allowed duty-free imports of 1 million tonnes of raw sugar until October 31. Balrampur Chini Mills and Dhampur Sugar Mills declined, reversing recent gains.
n40f8041fc8.why: Balrampur Chini Mills and Dhampur Sugar Mills are Indian sugar producers, so import policy affects domestic sugar prices and their margins.

nba162db2e0.headline: Alibaba quarterly profit drops 75% as AI investment spending grows
nba162db2e0.summary: Alibaba reported a 75% drop in quarterly profit as it invested heavily in AI infrastructure, while revenue from its AI-related services rose 45%.
nba162db2e0.why: Alibaba is a major Chinese e-commerce and cloud company, and its AI spending is a key test of returns on large tech capital expenditure.

n5ade227e82.summary: South Korean chipmaker Samsung Electronics said on Friday it would buy back up to $80 billion of its own shares to boost shareholder returns. The announcement was reported by the Oman Observer.
n5ade227e82.why: Samsung is a global leader in memory chips and smartphones, and share buybacks reduce shares outstanding and return cash to investors.

n16b3aa5d30.headline: I-Remit board clears Surepay deal
n16b3aa5d30.summary: Listed remittance firm I-Remit approved a binding term sheet with Surepay Technologies for a proposed P20-million capital infusion. Vice chairman Ben Tiu now owns a 47-percent stake, the company disclosed.
n16b3aa5d30.why: I-Remit is a Philippine-listed remittance company, and capital infusions and ownership changes affect its funding and governance.

nc13aa7279e.headline: Henlius' H1 Profit Rises 10%; Revenue Up 27% As Global Growth Accelerates
nc13aa7279e.summary: Henlius reported first-half 2026 revenue up 27.3% to RMB3.588 billion and net profit up 10.3% to RMB430.4 million. Earnings per share improved over the period.
nc13aa7279e.why: Henlius is a Shanghai-based biopharmaceutical company listed in Hong Kong, and its results show its progress in drug sales.

n5bf068fbc9.headline: PSE ramps up PDS integration
n5bf068fbc9.summary: The Philippine Stock Exchange is ramping up initiatives to integrate the Philippine Dealing System Holdings Corp. as part of efforts to build a more unified market infrastructure.
n5bf068fbc9.why: The Philippine Stock Exchange operates the country's main equity market, and consolidating market infrastructure affects trading and settlement efficiency.

n6b4b714e50.headline: Fuel prices going up again next week
n6b4b714e50.summary: Domestic fuel prices in the Philippines are set to rise again next week amid market uncertainty. The increase follows the expiry of an interim US-Iran agreement without a broader peace deal.
n6b4b714e50.why: Fuel price adjustments feed directly into transport costs, inflation and household spending in the Philippines, an economy closely watched by regional investors.

n4f3aafbd34.headline: 6.5 million Filipinos lifted out of poverty – PSA
n4f3aafbd34.summary: An estimated 6.5 million Filipinos were lifted out of poverty between 2023 and 2025. Poverty incidence fell to its lowest rate last year.
n4f3aafbd34.why: Poverty trends shape household consumption, a key driver of growth in the Philippine economy.

n6feee96323.headline: S. Korea to launch 'future fund' with 'windfall revenue' amid chip boom
n6feee96323.summary: South Korea will launch a 'Future Fund' to promote long-term economic growth, financed by what the government calls windfall revenue from higher tax collection. The chip industry boom is cited as the context.
n6feee96323.why: South Korea's economy and stock market are heavily weighted toward semiconductors, so government fiscal policy tied to chip-driven tax revenue matters to investors.

nfec424feb0.headline: Bank of Korea deputy chief says monetary policy to be made
nfec424feb0.summary: The new Bank of Korea deputy governor said monetary policy decisions would be made in the bank's usual process. Details in the source remain limited.
nfec424feb0.why: The Bank of Korea sets South Korea's policy rate, which influences the won, government bond yields and domestic lending.

ne722d1ed3a.headline: Japan PMI Accelerates as Manufacturing Leads Broad-Based August Growth
ne722d1ed3a.summary: Japan's composite PMI rose to 53.4 in August as manufacturing and services strengthened. AI-related demand drove export growth.
ne722d1ed3a.why: The PMI is a monthly survey of business activity, and it is watched by investors as an early indicator of Japan's economic momentum.

naad690a9f0.headline: Japan Inflation Is Broadening Again — Core-Core at 1.9% Strengthens BoJ Hike Case
naad690a9f0.summary: Japan's headline CPI rose to 1.9% in July and core-core inflation also reached 1.9%. The data strengthens the case for a Bank of Japan rate hike in September.
naad690a9f0.why: The Bank of Japan sets policy for Japanese rates and the yen, and inflation data shapes its decisions.

n8b56a23cd4.headline: JC&C to sell Singapore and Malaysia auto businesses for $265m
n8b56a23cd4.summary: JC&C has agreed to sell its Cycle & Carriage automotive businesses in Singapore and Malaysia to a unit of Indonesia-listed PT Chandra Asri Pacific for $265 million.
n8b56a23cd4.why: Cycle & Carriage is a regional automotive distributor, and divestitures reshape the portfolios of listed Southeast Asian conglomerates.

n7a8f74ea88.headline: Another Power Unit Returned to Operation Early; Nuclear Plant Repair Campaign Continues – Energoatom
n7a8f74ea88.summary: Energoatom returned the sixth of nine power units at the nuclear plant to operation ahead of schedule. It is expected to add 210 million kWh of electricity.
n7a8f74ea88.why: Energoatom is Ukraine's state nuclear power operator, and restoring reactors increases domestic electricity supply.

n0b474ba0c1.summary: The Athens general index moved above 2,600, led by banks, with new highs for Motor Oil and CrediaBank while HelleniQ Energy halted its upward trend.
n0b474ba0c1.why: The Athens Stock Exchange is Greece's main equity market, and bank and energy stocks make up a large share of its benchmark index.
